echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse
echo_sets.note: Best Havoc set for a Havoc main DPS; Dreamless deals huge AoE and its damage increases when cast after Rover's Liberation.

echo_sets.name: Havoc Eclipse + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Game8's 2nd-best: mixes Havoc DMG and ATK% when your best substats are split across the two sets.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; Energy Regen is the #3 substat priority after Crit Rate/Crit DMG — take it on substats so the Liberation stays available
build.fast_path: Fast path: Emerald of Genesis + 5-piece Havoc Eclipse in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Dreamless in the main slot. Crit Rate/Crit DMG 4-cost, Havoc DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs. Open with Resonance Skill for instant Forte charge, fill the Forte gauge, enter Dark Surge with Heavy Attack, then Liberation into Dreamless for the signature nuke.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's best weapon: Crit Rate substat, high base ATK, and Energy Regen plus stacking ATK on Resonance Skill. Obtainable from the standard weapon convene — not a limited signature.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's top 4-star: ATK% on Intro Skill; the best accessible option.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: Battle-pass 4-star; Basic and Heavy Attack DMG buffs suit the Dark Surge playstyle.

ranked_weapons.name: Lunar Cutter
ranked_weapons.note: ATK stacks on entering the field; solid standard-pool pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Overture
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable option that restores Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill — good for faster rotations.

stat_priorities.note: Crit main stat; balance to the 1:2 ratio.

profile.role_note: Free on-field Havoc carry: charges the Forte gauge to enter the Dark Surge state, then unloads enhanced combos and a Liberation-into-Dreamless nuke.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free after the 'Grand Warstorm' quest around Union Level 20 — there's nothing to pull. One of the strongest free main DPS characters in any gacha; if your account lacks a Havoc carry, build them and don't look back.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves: Havoc Rover Build Guide
Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Havoc Rover
members.note: Main DPS; enters Dark Surge and stays on-field for extended enhanced combos.

members.name: Yangyang
members.note: Documented sub-DPS option: groups enemies with her Liberation and refunds energy to the Rover via Outro.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and grants Crit Rate/Crit DMG inside her Stellarealm; her second Inherent Skill adds 10% Energy Regen for the Rover.

teams.name: Premium: Havoc Rover + Yangyang + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper sets her Stellarealm, Yangyang groups enemies and Outros energy into the Rover, the Rover opens with Resonance Skill for instant Forte charge, enters Dark Surge, and cycles Liberation into Dreamless for the nuke.

members.name: Havoc Rover
members.note: Main DPS; Basic ATK-deepened by Sanhua for maximum Dark Surge damage.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Documented sub-DPS: her Outro deepens Basic ATK DMG, which the Rover's Dark Surge state is built around.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free universal healer/buffer; documented support replacement whose Outro deepens team damage.

teams.name: Budget: Havoc Rover + Sanhua + Verina
teams.rotation: Sanhua builds Concerto with her ice structures and Outros into the Rover with Basic ATK DMG deepened — the Rover runs their full Dark Surge combo, Liberation into Dreamless, and loops back to Sanhua; Verina heals and buffs between rotations.

tier_badge.label: Excellent
tier_badge.note: Game8 rates them A overall as a Main DPS and PocketGamer lists Havoc Rover as S/A situational — a free carry with a huge Liberation-into-Dreamless nuke; Beebom's 3.7 list is more conservative at B as newer Havoc DPS arrive.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete free kit. Reach S2 for the skill-cooldown reset, S4 adds team-wide Havoc shred, S6 is the long-term free goal.

pull_path.why: Free 5-star with a full Dark Surge rotation at S0.
Entering Dark Surge resets the Resonance Skill cooldown - reachable free via progression.
Devastation and Deadening Abyss reduce enemy Havoc RES by 10% for 20s.
+25% Crit Rate in Dark Surge; long-term free goal, not a spending target.

nodes.name: Cryptic Insight
nodes.effect: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.

nodes.name: Waning Crescent
nodes.effect: Entering Dark Surge by casting Heavy Attack Devastation resets the Resonance Skill cooldown.

nodes.name: Surging Resonance
nodes.effect: In Dark Surge, Basic Attack 5 restores HP equal to 10% of HP lost on hit.

nodes.name: Annihilated Silence
nodes.effect: Devastation and Deadening Abyss reduce enemy Havoc RES by 10% for 20s on hit.

nodes.name: Aeon Symphony
nodes.effect: In Dark Surge, Basic Attack 5 deals +50% additional Havoc DMG.

nodes.name: Ebbing Undercurrent
nodes.effect: In Dark Surge, Crit Rate is increased by 25%.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: No signature weapon - S2 and S4 come free from progression; Emerald of Genesis is the standard-banner pick.
